holdings.name: Laurus Labs Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 sales rose to ₹2,026 crore from ₹1,812 crore in March 2026, while operating profit margin expanded to 32% and net profit increased to ₹362 crore.
Laurus Labs invested ₹12.10 crore in the KRPL rights issue, keeping its equity holding at 26%.

holdings.why_it_matters: Laurus Labs is the fund's largest reported position at 4.03%. Its 32.76% 3-month gain contributed +1.32% estimated to fund returns, offsetting broad drags in other holdings.

holdings.name: Steel Authority Of India Ltd

what_changed.text: CareEdge reaffirmed SAIL ratings and revised its outlook to Positive on ₹14,850 crore long-term facilities.
SAIL signed an MoU with BCCL to jointly develop two coal blocks in West Bengal.
Crude steel production reached 9.6 MT in the April-September period.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.54% fund weight, SAIL is the second largest single holding. A modest 2.39% 3-month return provided stability against wider industrial corrections.

holdings.name: Lupin Ltd

what_changed.text: Lupin launched Formoflo-G MDI, a fixed-dose triple COPD inhaler in India.
The company received US FDA approval for Phytonadione Injectable Emulsion USP, targeting a market with estimated U.S. sales of $52.3 million.
June 2026 revenue expanded to ₹8,277 crore, while operating profit margin softened to 30% from 33% in March 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Lupin carries a 3.26% weight. Its -22.37% 3-month return shaved an estimated -0.729% off fund performance, creating a strong divergence from peer Laurus Labs.

holdings.name: Indusind Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: As of September 30, 2026, net advances grew 11.2% and deposits expanded 10.1%, with ₹33,000 crore mobilised via FCNR(B) deposits.
Gross NPA improved to 3.25% in June 2026 from 3.43% in March 2026, while net profit rose to ₹1,037 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 3.18% of the fund, the bank's -15.79% 3-month drop contributed -0.502% estimated drag, compounding weakness across the portfolio's 25.6% financials allocation.

watch.text: The board meets on October 23, 2026, to review and approve Q2 and H1 FY2026-27 financial results.

holdings.name: Persistent Systems Ltd

what_changed.text: Persistent reached a 94.04% stake in Nagarro following its voluntary takeover offer, planning a full squeeze-out by Q1 CY27.
ICRA assigned an AA+ rating on watch negative for proposed ₹5,000 crore NCDs, while reaffirming the issuer rating at AA+.
Chief Delivery Officer Dr. Rajesh Gharpure resigned effective October 14, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 3.13% weight, Persistent delivered an 11.45% return over 3 months (+0.358% estimated contribution), making it the primary positive driver within the 8.1% technology sleeve.

holdings.name: PB Fintech Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 net profit fell quarter-on-quarter to ₹163 crore from ₹261 crore in March 2026, with revenue dropping to ₹1,888 crore.
PB Fintech infused ₹1 crore into its wholly owned subsidiary PB Financial Account Aggregators Private Limited.
Nomura lowered its target price to ₹1,100, citing an insurance commission regulatory paper from IRDAI.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.02% weight, the stock fell -34.34% over 3 months, creating the fund's largest single negative contribution at -1.037% estimated.

holdings.name: HDB FINANCIAL SERVICES LIMITED EQ

what_changed.text: Company Secretary and Head Legal Dipti Jayesh Khandelwal resigned effective October 30, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Accounting for 2.97% of the portfolio, its -22.58% 3-month decline cost the fund an estimated -0.671%, intensifying financial sector drawdowns.

watch.text: The board meets on October 14, 2026, to review Q2 and half-year FY26 results and consider an interim dividend.

holdings.name: Delhivery Ltd

what_changed.text: Operating profit margin declined to 4.8% in June 2026 from 8% in March 2026, as net profit declined to ₹32 crore.
The company granted 52,600 stock options under ESOP 2012 following the approval of 9,00,000 ESOP options at the AGM.

holdings.why_it_matters: Carrying a 2.88% fund allocation, Delhivery's -19.55% 3-month performance generated a -0.563% estimated drag within the industrials basket.

holdings.name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd

what_changed.text: Dixon entered a 60/40 joint venture with Gemtek to manufacture optical transceivers via Dixon Electroconnect, targeting completion by February 3, 2027.
Subsidiary DEAPL signed an intellectual property licence agreement with Aviat Networks to manufacture microwave radios.
June 2026 net profit recovered to ₹718 crore compared to ₹298 crore in March 2026, though operating margin dipped to 3.0%.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.82% weight in Consumer Discretionary, its -6.15% 3-month return matched broader fund weakness despite strong trailing 6-month momentum (+20.53%).

holdings.name: Bharat Forge Ltd

what_changed.text: Bharat Forge signed a long-term supply agreement with Pratt & Whitney Canada for aerospace engine components.
Results turned to a net loss of ₹90 crore in June 2026 from a ₹233 crore profit in March 2026 as operating margin shrank to 15%.
The Delhi High Court dismissed an appeal from T K Jain on October 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: A 2.75% allocation in the stock exerted pressure on the fund after a -15.39% 3-month slide, driven by the shift into quarterly net losses.

portfolio.statement: Financials and logistics holdings dragged Mirae Asset Midcap Fund down 6.21% over 3 months, outweighing substantial gains in select CDMO and IT holdings.
interp: Concentrated sell-offs in Financials (PB Fintech, HDB Financial, IndusInd Bank) erased over 2.2% in combined fund return contribution.
Outperformance remained highly company-specific, led by Laurus Labs' operational surge and Persistent Systems' takeover of Nagarro.
portfolio.line: Heavy financial sector losses offset solitary rallies in healthcare and tech.

drivers.text: Laurus Labs gained 32.76% over 3 months as quarterly net profit climbed to ₹362 crore with 32% operating margins.
PB Fintech plunged 34.34% over 3 months amid regulatory uncertainty surrounding IRDAI insurance commission proposals and sequential profit contraction.
Lupin declined 22.37% over 3 months despite securing US FDA approval for Phytonadione and launching a COPD inhaler in India.

themes.title: M&A and Capacity Expansions
themes.text: Portfolio firms are committing capital to inorganic additions and product expansions to secure long-term positioning.

themes.title: Margin and Profit Volatility
themes.text: Several prominent holdings experienced margin squeezes or sudden operational losses in the June 2026 quarter.

macro.why: IRDAI regulatory proposals on distributor commissions led to brokerage downgrades and valuation compression.

macro.factor: Raw Material Sourcing & Energy Input Integration
macro.why: Domestic industrial manufacturers are establishing joint ventures to secure mineral and coking coal assets.

priced_in.text: Persistent Systems securing a 94.04% acceptance in Nagarro ahead of planned squeeze-out proceedings.
PB Fintech facing commission pressure following the IRDAI paper, leading Nomura to cut its target price to ₹1,100.

could_change.title: Financial Earnings Rebound
could_change.text: IndusInd Bank (reporting October 23) and HDB Financial (reporting October 14) provide test points for net asset quality and quarterly credit growth.

could_change.title: Industrial Margin Stabilization
could_change.text: Turnaround from recent quarterly net losses at Bharat Forge and margin compression at Delhivery will determine if industrial names cease dragging fund performance.

portfolio.risk_note: With Financials accounting for 25.6% of the fund and three top banking/fintech holdings down between 15% and 35% in 3 months, prolonged weakness in lending and distribution will keep fund drawdown elevated.
